﻿Town of Avon – Public Land Records Data Use Agreement

The Town of Avon provides public access to GIS data for viewing, printing, and limited sharing. While efforts are made to ensure accuracy, data may contain errors or change over time. Users must not alter, misuse, or misrepresent the data. All data remains the property of the Town and may not be redistributed without proper attribution.


The Town is not liable for any loss or damage resulting from use of this data. Continued use implies acceptance of these terms. For questions, contact the GIS Department at GIS@avon.org
